source: 794 The Price of Meddling
target: 794 Pretium Immiscendi

source: 794 The Price of Meddling
target: 794 Pretium Immiscendi

source: Behind Lumian, Vijepan continued questioning Heraberg, the clergy of the Church of Knowledge, “In a legal duel, can I do anything to the other party without facing punishment?”
target: Retro Lumian, Vijepan Herabergum, clericum Ecclesiae Cognitionis, interrogare continuavit: “In certamine legali, licetne mihi adversario aliquid agere, ne poena afficiar?”

source: “Yes,” Heraberg confirmed.
target: “Ita,” Heraberg confirmavit.

source: Vijepan’s eyes lit up, feeling as if he had found paradise.
target: Oculi Vijepanis fulserunt, quasi paradisum invenisset.

source: He excitedly swallowed.
target: Ille alacriter deglutivit.

source: Gulp… He heard a similar sound next to him.
target: “Gulp…” Iuxta se similem sonum audivit.

source: He turned his head and saw that the sound came from a woman with long brown hair, Julie.
target: Caput vertit et vidit sonum provenire a muliere cum longis capillis fuscis, Iulia.

source: The “collector” was also excited, while the human chef, Lez, licked his lips.
target: “Collector” quoque excitatus erat, dum coquus humanus, Lez, labia linguit.

source: He was already hungry.
target: Iam esuriebat.

source: Lumian didn’t bother watching the other offenders’ performances.
target: Lumian non curavit spectare ostentationes reliquorum sceleratorum.

source: He left the library-like cathedral and surveyed the surroundings.
target: Lumian ecclesiam, quasi bibliothecam, reliquit et circumstantias perlustrare coepit.

source: The buildings in this area were ancient, reminiscent of early Fifth Epoch styles with their heavy columns and arches, giving a sense of grandeur and simplicity.
target: Aedificia huius regionis antiqua erant, quae stilis primis Quinti Aevi similia erant, columnis gravibus et arcubus ornata, sensum maiestatis et simplicitatis praebentia.

source: Behind the cathedral was a seemingly endless graveyard.
target: Post ecclesiam, coemeterium quasi infinitum erat.

source: Tombstones stood amidst the trees, with many raised graves dotting the landscape.
target: Lapides sepulcrales inter arbores stabant, cum multa sepulcra elevata terram punctabant.

source: This reminded Lumian of a line from the 0-01 sealed information: “Place it in an underground mausoleum with a large number of soldier mannequins. Construct a cemetery with more than a million corpses above it…”
target: Hoc recordatus est Lumian de linea ex notitia sigillata 0-01: “In mausoleo subterraneo, cum magna multitudine simulacrorum militum, pone id. Erige coemeterium cum plus quam uno millione cadaverum super eo…”

source: Is the underground mausoleum sealing 0-01 right below?
target: Num mausoleum subterraneum, quod 0-01 sigillans, infra iacet?

source: Just as Lumian withdrew his gaze, the previously sunny sky darkened.
target: Simul ac Lumian oculos avertit, quondam serenus caelum obscuratum est.

source: Thick clouds gathered, and the sound of thunder rumbled.
target: Nubes spissae congressae sunt, et sonus tonitrui fremuit.

source: The weather changes so quickly…
target: Tempestas tam celeriter mutatur…

source: No wonder the information mentioned Morora frequently experiencing extreme weather…
target: Non mirum quod notitia refert Mororam saepe tempestatibus extremis experiri.

source: Lumian sighed as he looked into the distance, seeing mountain ranges resembling giant beasts lying at the horizon, blocking anyone who might want to leave secretly.
target: Lumian suspiravit, dum in longinquum intuebatur, videns catenae montium, similes ingentibus bestiis in horizonte iacentes, qui celate discedere cuivis impediabant.

source: Of course, this was just a metaphor, as the residents of Morora never thought of leaving the city.
target: Certe, hoc solum erat metaphorum, quoniam incolae Mororae urbem relinquere numquam cogitabant.

source: Lumian felt a slight reluctance too.
target: Lumian etiam parvam repugnationem sensit.

source: The underground was calling to him.
target: Subterra eum vocabat.

source: “We need to find a place to settle down quickly, or we’ll get soaked,” Guei’s voice came from beside Lumian.
target: “Celeriter locum habitandi invenire debemus, cum aliter madidi erimus,” vox Guei prope Lumian pronuntiata est.

source: He had also left the cathedral, and as a local of Azshara, his words were quite formal.
target: Etiam ecclesiam reliquit, et ut vicinus Azsharae, verba eius note formalia erant.

source: “Yeah,” Lumian replied with a smile as he walked into the large square in front of the cathedral.
target: “Ita,” respondit Lumian sub risu, dum in magnam forum coram ecclesia ambulabat.

source: Guei followed, glancing back and saying in surprise, “There’s such a large graveyard here?”
target: Guei secutus est, retro speculans atque obstupescens dicens: “Hic coemeterium tam magnum est?”

source: “A graveyard with over a million, even tens of millions of corpses,” Lumian replied casually.
target: “Coemeterium cum plus quam uno millione, etiam decies milliones cadaverum,” respondit Lumian leviter.

source: Guei nodded thoughtfully.
target: Guei cogitavit et annuit.

source: “History books record a large-scale grave relocation in the early Fifth Epoch in the Lenburg region to address the aftermath of the Pale Disaster. Was it moved here?”
target: “Libri historiae memorant magnam translationem sepulchrale in initio Quinti Aevi in regione Lenburg ad remediandas consequentias Disasterum Pallidum. Num hic translata est?”

source: “Perhaps,” Lumian said as they crossed the square.
target: “Forsitan,” inquit Lumian dum forum transibant.

source: He quietly activated the black mark representing the Abscessed Hand, but did not actually use it.
target: Tacite notam nigrum repraesentantem Manum Abscessam activavit, sed re vera non usus est.

source: He was sensing the approximate location of the other two parts of the Abscessed Hand.
target: Sentiebat locum approximatum duarum reliquarum partium Manum Abscessae.

source: To his surprise, he sensed more than two parts.
target: Ad eius mirationem, plus quam duas partes sensit.

source: Different directions within the City of Exiles had subtle responses.
target: Diversae regiones intra Urbem Exilium responsa subtilia praebebant.

source: Hand Bro’s body parts got dismembered?
target: Partes corporis Hand Bro dissectae sunt?

source: Lumian silently muttered.
target: Lumian silentio mumuravit.

source: He chose the direction with the strongest response.
target: Elegit directionem cum maximo responsu.

source: After walking about a street’s length, he heard the clashing of metal and saw two men fiercely fighting with sharp swords as a crowd watched.
target: Postquam viae spatium perambulavit, sonitum metallorum audivit et duos viros acutis gladiis ferociter certantes vidit, dum multitudo spectabat.

source: Duels with fatalities happen daily…
target: Certamina mortifera quotidie fiunt…

source: Lumian reviewed the 0-01 sealed information.
target: Lumian notitia sigillata 0-01 recognovit.

source: He didn’t hurry, deciding to watch for a while.
target: Non festinavit, constitutus aliquantulum spectare.

source: Guei did the same, seemingly assessing the strength of Morora’s residents.
target: Guei idem fecit, fortitudinem incolarum Mororae aestimans.

source: The fight lasted two or three minutes, ending with a man in a black jacket being slashed across the chest and stomach, his intestines spilling out as he convulsed and died.
target: Pugna duas vel tres minutas duravit, finita cum viro in veste nigra pectore et abdomine lacerato, cui intestina effusa erant, dum convulsus mortuusque est.

source: A team of men and women in black robes, their expressions indifferent, appeared, silently dragging the stripped corpse away and cleaning the blood from the street, like machines following a set procedure.
target: Grex virorum et feminarum in vestibus nigris, vultu indifferente, apparuit, corpus spoliatum tacite trahebant et sanguinem e via purgabant, quasi machinae praeordinatae.

source: The onlookers dispersed.
target: Spectatores se dissipaverunt.

source: A small man in a brown-green cap, smiling kindly, walked past Lumian and Guei, glancing at them.
target: Vir parvus in pileo fusco-viridi, benigno risu, praeter Lumian et Guei ambulavit, eos circumspectans.

source: “New here?” the small man asked warmly.
target: “Novus hic?” inquit parvus vir calide.

source: “How can you tell?” Guei asked curiously.
target: “Quomodo hoc agnoscis?” inquit Guei curiosus.

source: The small man laughed.
target: Parvus vir risit.

source: “You still have that new look, not yet fully integrated into Morora!”
target: “Adhuc illam novam speciem geris, nondum plene in Morora integra es!”

source: His voice suddenly turned sharp, as if possessed by something unknown.
target: Vox eius subito acuta facta est, quasi ab ignoto possessa.

source: Lumian watched the small man in silence, observing his changes.
target: Lumian parvum virum silentio observabat, mutationes eius contemplans.

source: The small man waved.
target: Parvus vir manum levavit.

source: “Haha, I’m Worms. Let’s have a drink sometime.”
target: “Haha, ego sum Worms. Bibamus aliquando.”

source: As Worms walked down another street, Guei suddenly spoke to Lumian, “Don’t you feel like you’re missing something?”
target: Dum Worms per aliam viam ambulabat, Guei repente ad Lumian locutus est: “Nonne tibi videtur aliquid deficere?”

source: “I noticed,” Lumian replied nonchalantly.
target: “Animadverti,” respondit Lumian leviter.

source: “He’s quick.”
target: “Celer est.”

source: He had only noticed his Traveler’s Bag was about to be taken when Worms withdrew his hand.
target: Modo animadvertit sacculum Viatoris sui sublaturum esse, cum Worms manum detraxit.

source: He must be a real Beyonder, a true Marauder.
target: Eum verum Beyonder esse oportet, verum praedatorem.

source: That sudden state change was likely a performance to distract attention.
target: Illud subitum status mutatio verisimiliter actio fuit ad attentionem decipiendam.

source: “Why didn’t you expose him if you noticed? Afraid of retaliation?” Guei didn’t understand Lumian’s reaction.
target: “Cur eum non patefecisti, si animadvertisti? Timuisti ultioni?” Guei non intellexit reactionem Lumiani.

source: “I wanted to see what he would do,” Lumian replied with a smile, hands in his pockets, slowly following the route Worms had taken.
target: “Cupivi videre quid faceret,” respondit Lumian sub risu, manibus in sinu, lente sequens iter quod Worms cepit.

source: Guei watched his back for a while, then decided to find a place to stay first.
target: Guei post tergum eius aliquot tempora aspexit, deinde locum manendi invenire decrevit.

source: Once out of Lumian and Guei’s sight, Worms quickened his pace, darting through several alleys in a circuitous route.
target: Postquam a conspectu Lumiani et Guei evaserat, Worms celeritatem augebat, per varias semitas angustas circuitus.

source: After confirming he had shaken off any potential pursuers, he stopped in a secluded alley and took out a dark black coin pouch from inside his clothes.
target: Postquam certior fecit se insequentibus evulsum esse, in angusto viculo secluso subsedit et ex vestimentis suis sacculum nigrum extraxit.

source: It was Lumian’s Traveler’s Bag.
target: Id erat Saccus Viatoris Lumiani.

source: “Haha, these new fools are so careless. Let’s see what’s inside…” Worms reached into the Traveler’s Bag.
target: “Haha, hi novi stulti tam neglegentes sunt. Videamus quid intus sit…” Worms manum in Saccum Viatoris protendit.

source: His expression changed slightly, filled with intense surprise.
target: Vultus eius modice mutatus est, plena intensa admiratione.

source: He could “see” the pouch’s value, sensing many items with spirituality inside, but he hadn’t expected it to be a rare spatial item, holding what felt like a small room.
target: Poterat «videre» valorem sacci, sentiens multa instrumenta spiritualitatis intus, sed non exspectaverat id esse rarum rem spatiale, quod quasi parvam cellam contineret.

source: What a pleasant surprise… Worms pulled out one of the items.
target: Quam iucunda sorpresa… Worms unum ex rebus extraxit.

source: What greeted his eyes was a half-decomposed, dark blue swollen corpse, dripping yellowish-red pus.
target: Quod oculis eius obviam fuit, corpus semi-decompositum, caeruleum obscurum et tumescentem, ex quo pus flavus-ruber stillabat.

source: Smack!
target: Ictus!

source: Worms recoiled, letting the half-corpse fall to the ground.
target: Worms recubuit, sinens corpus semi-decompositum in terram cadere.

source: Wh- His face turned horrified.
target: Heu—facies eius territa facta est.

source: Who carries a half-decomposed corpse around?
target: Quis corpus semi-decompositum circum fert?

source: And a highly decayed corpse at that!
target: Atque corpus valde corruptum!

source: Even in Morora, filled with countless murderers, this is the most twisted thing!
target: Etiam in Morora, cum innumerabilibus homicidibus, hoc est res maxime tortuosa!

source: No wonder he was exiled here!
target: Non mirum, hic exsul factus est!

source: Steadying himself, Worms reached into the Traveler’s Bag again, pulling out a piece of smooth, white leather.
target: Se confirmans, Worms iterum in Saccum Viatoris manum intulit et partem cori album, lenis, extraxit.

source: He couldn’t take his eyes off it, as if staring at the skin of a dream lover.
target: Oculos ab eo deferrere non potuit, quasi cutem dilecti somnorum contemplans.

source: He quickly noticed some black words on the leather that he didn’t recognize.
target: Celeriter animadvertit verba nigra in corio, quae ignorabat.

source: Seems to be words that can trigger Beyonder powers.
target: Videtur verba esse quae potestates Beyonder excitare possint.

source: This leather must be very valuable.
target: Hoc corium valde pretiosum esse debet.

source: I should copy it and find someone to decipher it without arousing suspicion, Worms thought in delight, caressing the leather, unwilling to let go.
target: Debeo id scribere et aliquem invenire qui id enodare possit sine suspicione excitanda, Worms laetus cogitavit, corium fovens, nec dimittere volens.

source: Suddenly, he felt his throat itch.
target: Subito fauces eius prurire coeperunt.

source: Cough, cough, cough!
target: Tussis, tussis, tussis!

source: He started coughing, more and more violently.
target: Tussire coepit, magis atque magis violenter.

source: Within seconds, he coughed so hard it felt like his heart would tear apart.
target: In paucis secundis, tam vehementer tussivit ut cor eius quasi discindatur.

source: Pfft!
target: Pfft!

source: Worms spat out a mouthful of blood.
target: Worms os plenum sanguinis exspuit.

source: This isn’t right! How did I suddenly get so sick?
target: Hoc non rectum est! Quomodo subito ita male aegrotare coepi?

source: Worms, vaguely understanding, threw the leather to the ground.
target: Worms, vix intellegens, corium in terram iecit.

source: But his coughing continued, even more violently.
target: Sed tussis eius continuavit, etiam magis violenter.

source: While coughing, he thought of a way to save himself: That guy put such dangerous leather in his pocket, he must have prepared a cure…
target: Dum tussiret, cogitavit modum se servandi: ille vir tam periculosum corium in sinu posuerat, debet curam praeparasse…

source: Yes, there must be one!
target: Ita, unum esse debet!

source: Worms reached into the Traveler’s Bag again.
target: Worms iterum in Saccum Viatoris manum protendit.

source: He first pulled out a gray-white lightning-shaped brooch.
target: Primum extraxit fibulam in formam fulminis, cinereo-albam.

source: A thick, silvery-white lightning bolt suddenly descended from the stacked clouds, striking him.
target: Subito e nubibus superpositis densus, argenteo-albus fulmen descendit, eum percutiens.

source: Boom!
target: Boom!

source: The thunder echoed, and Worms fell, his body charred and twitching.
target: Tonitrua resonaverunt, et Worms cecidit, corpus eius comburatum et convulsum.

source: Already gravely ill, the lightning strike left him near death.
target: Iam graviter aegrotans, ictus fulminis eum prope mortem reliquit.

source: How… how could I suddenly be struck… by lightning… I, I… Worms’s vision darkened, his confusion and regret lingering as he closed his eyes.
target: Quomodo… quomodo repentinus fulmine percussus sim… Ego… Visio Worms obscurata est, et confusio atque paenitentia remanserunt, dum oculos clausit.

source: He soon stopped breathing.
target: Cito respirare desiit.

source: About ten seconds later, Lumian turned into the alley, walked to Worms, looked down at his body, and shook his head with a smile.
target: Circa decem secundis post, Lumian in viculum se vertit, ad Worms ambulavit, corpus eius respexit, et caput sub risu movit.

source: “Rummaging through others’ belongings is very dangerous.”
target: “In rebus alienis scrutari periculosum est.”

source: After a pause, Lumian regrettably sighed.
target: Post brevem silentium, Lumian tristis suspiravit.

source: “I wanted to follow you and get in touch with Morora’s Beyonders. You let me down.
target: “Te sequi et cum Beyonderibus Morora convenire volui. Me deludisti.

source: “And you didn’t even get to the more dangerous items.”
target: Et ne gravioribus rebus quidem attigisti.”

source: As he spoke, Lumian picked up the Traveler’s Bag, placing the items back inside in their compressed form: the Fury of the Sea brooch, the Demoness of Despair human leather, and the half‐corpse of the Abscessed Hand.
target: Dum loquebatur, Lumian Saccum Viatoris sustulit, et res in eadem forma compressa reposuit: fibulam “Furor Maris”, corium humanum “Demonissa Desperationis”, et corpus semi-decompositum “Manum Abscessae”.

source: “I guess being a generous soul is all you can do,” Lumian muttered, extracting 537 sassen gold from Worms.
target: “Animam largam habere, id credo, est totum quod facere potes,” muspitavit Lumian, extrahens 537 sassen aurei ex Worms.

source: That was about 2863 verl d’or.
target: Id fere erat 2863 verl d’or.

source: Pocketing the generous soul’s gift, Lumian waited for Worms’s Beyonder characteristics to manifest.
target: Donum animae largae in sinu condidens, Lumian exspectavit ut proprietates Beyonder Worms manifestae essent.

source: About two minutes later, a team of black-robed enforcers entered the alley.
target: Circiter post duas minutas, grex exsecutorum in vestibus nigris in viculum intravit.

source: The leader looked at Lumian expressionlessly and said, “Did you kill him?”
target: Dux, sine vultu, Lumian intuebatur et dixit: “Num eum occidisti?”

source: “No, he was struck by lightning. Maybe he did too many bad things,” Lumian replied with a smile, explaining earnestly.
target: “Non, fulmine percussus est. Forsitan nimis multa mala fecerit,” respondit Lumian sub risu, sincere explicans.

source: “He was a thief and stole my stuff, so I chased him here.”
target: “Fur erat et res meas abstulit, itaque eum huc persecutus sum.”

source: The enforcers stared at Lumian as if verifying his truthfulness.
target: Exsecutores Lumian intuebantur, quasi veritatem eius comprobarent.

source: After a moment, the leader nodded.
target: Post momentum, dux annuit.

source: “You may leave.”
target: “Discedere licet.”

source: Lumian didn’t move, smiling as he said, “His belongings should be mine, right?”
target: Lumian non movebat, subrisu dicens: “Possessiones eius mihi esse debent, nonne?”
